cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
첨상에서 필비 떴다!
내 졸업 단검이야!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle three-quarter shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD webtoon style on a pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, Gnome Rogue with both daggers sheathed at her waist leaps excitedly with starry eyes and raised empty fists over minimal stone floor tiles. Beside a tiny knocked-out cute 2.5-head chibi SD armored orc warchief boss and an open treasure chest, a small glowing purple epic dagger floats with sparkles.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.visual_prompt: Angled medium close-up shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD webtoon style on a pure #FFFFFF background. On the right, Orc Warrior with her sturdy shield strapped on her back and basic weapon sheathed leans in eagerly with sparkling eyes and a grin. She gazes toward the small glowing purple epic dagger floating on the left.

equip_effects: 발동 효과: 다음 3초 동안의 모든 공격은 치명타 및 극대화로 적중됩니다.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
전사가 단검을 왜 굴려?!
방패는 폼이야?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dutch-tilt diagonal shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD webtoon style on a pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, Orc Warrior with her basic weapon sheathed and shield strapped on her back happily tosses a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold cube with round dot pips only (no digits) to claim the glowing purple epic dagger. On the right, Gnome Rogue with daggers sheathed leans forward waving both empty hands in furious protest.

Extreme close-up big bust-up filling 80% of the frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD webtoon style on a pure #FFFFFF background. Gnome Rogue dead-center freezes in absolute shock with pale face, blank wide eyes, waterfalls of bright light-blue watery anime tears (strictly cyan-blue water tears, zero pink or red tears) streaming down her cheeks, and a tiny chibi ghost soul floating out of her head.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
봐, 영격 팡팡 터지네!
탱커한테 최고 맞지?
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle comedic shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD webtoon style on a pure #FFFFFF background. On the right, Orc Warrior wearing her sturdy shield proudly swings the tiny glowing purple epic dagger in one hand with bright orange strike sparks. On the left, Gnome Rogue lies face-down slumped flat on minimal stone floor tiles in utter defeat.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
울지 마, 도적아.
다음엔 보기랑 야드 가자.
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-by-side medium shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD webtoon style on a pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, Dwarf Hunter with her wooden blunderbuss slung on her back gently pats the shoulder of the weeping Gnome Rogue on the right with a calm deadpan smile. Beside Dwarf Hunter, her cute 2.5-head chibi SD baby brown bear cub sits and tilts its head sympathetically.
